advancements.trimworks.pattern.dune_temp: Enter a desert temple. Requires a full Dune set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.eye_drago: Meet the Ender Dragon, or carry its egg. Requires a full Eye set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.rib_fortr: Enter a Nether Fortress. Requires a full Rib set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.rib_withe: Meet the Wither. Requires a full Rib set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.sentry_en: Meet a pillager or ravager. Requires a full Sentry set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.sentry_ra: Be inside an active village raid. Requires a full Sentry set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.silence_w: Meet the Warden. Requires a full Silence set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.silence_s: Kill an enemy whose XP feeds a sculk catalyst. Requires a full Silence set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.silence_d: Mark a mob with your still-active spectral glow, then kill it from at least 20 blocks away while wearing a full Silence set. The Warden is not the only one with reach.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.snout_bas: Enter a bastion remnant. Requires a full Snout set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.vex_mansi: Enter a woodland mansion. Requires a full Vex set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.vex_evoke: Slay an Evoker. Requires a full Vex set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.wild_temp: Enter a jungle temple. Requires a full Wild set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.ward_ward: Stay within 32 blocks of the same calm or suspicious Warden for 60 continuous seconds, without dying or letting it become angry. Its anger must never exceed 100. Requires a full Ward set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.ward_slay: Slay a Warden in an ancient city while wearing a full Ward set. Are you sure you've done the right thing?
advancements.trimworks.materials.title: Materials Matter
advancements.trimworks.materials.descrip: Explore trim material bonuses and their challenges.
advancements.trimworks.material.amethyst: Upgrade the primary enchantment 50 times with the active four-piece Amethyst bonus.
advancements.trimworks.material.copper_l: Be struck by lightning while wearing an active four-piece Copper set.
advancements.trimworks.material.diamond_: Apply a Diamond trim to leather armor.
Apply a Diamond trim to Netherite armor.
advancements.trimworks.material.emerald_: Complete 50 merchant trades while wearing an active four-piece Emerald set.
advancements.trimworks.material.gold_bar: Complete 50 piglin barters while wearing an active four-piece Gold set.
advancements.trimworks.material.lapis_le: Gain 20 cumulative levels from earned XP while wearing an active four-piece Lapis set. Progress starts at zero and survives death and XP spending.
advancements.trimworks.material.netherit: Apply a Netherite trim to armor made from another material.
advancements.trimworks.material.quartz_f: Find a generated Nether fossil within four blocks while wearing an active four-piece Quartz set. Perhaps a little lost ghast needs a home?
advancements.trimworks.material.quartz_g: Home Is Where the Ghast Is
Leash or harness a happy ghast while wearing an active four-piece Quartz set. From stray to sky-high companion.
advancements.trimworks.material.resin_ho: Collect five bottles of honey from hives or nests while wearing an active four-piece Resin set.
advancements.trimworks.material.redstone: Travel 1,000 cumulative blocks while wearing an active four-piece Redstone set.
advancements.trimworks.naturally_trimmed: Explore trimmed armor and empowered monsters with Naturally Trimmed installed.
Slay a monster wearing at least one trimmed armor piece. Requires Naturally Trimmed.
Slay a monster with a currently active Trimworks effect or attribute bonus. Requires Naturally Trimmed.
Obtain a piece of trimmed armor. Requires Naturally Trimmed.
Buy a piece of trimmed armor from a villager. Requires Naturally Trimmed.

advancements.trimworks.full_sets.title: Dressed for Adventure
advancements.trimworks.full_sets.descrip: Explore full matching trim sets and their challenges.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.bolt_tria: Complete five regular or ominous trial spawners in total. Requires a full Bolt set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.bolt_bree: Slay a Breeze. Requires a full Bolt set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.coast_shi: Enter any shipwreck, including a beached one. Requires a full Coast set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.coast_tre: Find buried treasure. Requires a full Coast set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.dune_hung: Take a Husk hit that leaves you with Hunger. Requires a full Dune set.
Enter an End city or its ship. Requires a full Eye set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.snout_dea: Be killed by a piglin brute or hoglin inside a bastion remnant. Requires a full Snout set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.tide_guar: Slay 50 Guardians in total. Requires a full Tide set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.tide_elde: Slay an Elder Guardian. Requires a full Tide set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.wild_trip: Trigger an unpowered tripwire inside a jungle temple. Requires a full Wild set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.wayfinder: Fall 200 cumulative blocks. Flight, gliding, swimming and riding do not count. Requires a full Wayfinder set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.spire_bos: Slay the Ender Dragon, Wither, Elder Guardian or Warden. Requires a full Spire set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.spire_shu: Slay ten Shulkers in total. Requires a full Spire set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.shaper_di: Find five diamonds in newly opened generated structure loot chests. Requires a full Shaper set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.host_ruin: Visit trail ruins at night. Requires a full Host set.
advancements.trimworks.pattern.flow_tria: Complete five ominous trial spawners. Requires a full Flow set.
